_doc.objective: 'ACS' maximizes predicted Adaptive Communication Score (default); 'BER' minimizes predicted BER
_doc.min_confidence: optional extra gate on the normalized predicted-objective margin [0..1]; DEFAULT 0.0 = disabled. The margin scale depends on the objective magnitude, so a fixed cutoff like 0.5 can make switching impossible for small-magnitude objectives (e.g. ACS ~0.2-0.9). Anti-chatter is provided by switch_margin_acs/rel + min_dwell_frames; raise this only if switching proves too jittery
_doc.switch_margin_acs: absolute predicted-objective advantage required to switch away from current waveform (inherited from phase-1 adaptive_config.json default 0.01; strict > comparison)
_doc.switch_margin_rel: relative predicted-objective advantage required to switch; either absolute OR relative threshold suffices (phase-1 convention)
